$comment: E-Myth Revisited — interventions. All with expected_evidence are mandatory.

interventions.name: Capacity Ledger (hours per client)
interventions.expected_evidence: Table: active clients × actual hours/week + remaining capacity + written decision 'accept/hold/reject' for new clients based on numbers — used before the next commitment
interventions.contraindicated_until: Klien aktif <2 — ledger kapasitas tanpa beban nyata mengukur kehampaan

interventions.name: SOP for the Single Most Frequent Process
interventions.expected_evidence: 1 written SOP (numbered steps, followable by someone else) for the most time-consuming process + 1 test: someone else/a document version completes it without asking you
interventions.contraindicated_until: Proses belum dijalankan ≥3 kali — SOP dari satu kali jalan mengunci cara yang belum terbukti

interventions.name: Org Chart Masa Depan (3 topi)
interventions.expected_evidence: 1-page org chart: Entrepreneur/Manager/Technician hats + this week's task list marked with which hat holds each one + 1 technician task moved out (to an SOP/person) this week
interventions.contraindicated_until: Belum menjalani ≥1 siklus delivery penuh — org chart masa depan tanpa pengalaman siklus jadi latihan kosong

interventions.name: Working ON vs IN (2 jam/minggu)
interventions.expected_evidence: 2 blok jam/minggu dikhususkan bekerja PADA bisnis (SOP, kapasitas, sistem) — bukan di dalamnya; 4 minggu beruntun tercatat di kalender + 1 perbaikan sistem per bulan terjadi
interventions.contraindicated_until: Beban IN (delivery) <5 jam/minggu — jam ON tanpa IN nyata tidak punya bahan untuk disistemkan
